description: Test suite for LDAP-related API endpoints in Mattermost, including testing LDAP connection, synchronization, group management, and certificate uploads.

methods.name: TestTestLdap
methods.description: Tests the LDAP connection and error handling for LDAP testing endpoint.

methods.name: TestSyncLdap
methods.description: Tests LDAP synchronization process, including license checks and mock synchronization job start.

methods.name: TestGetLdapGroups
methods.description: Tests retrieval of LDAP groups with permission checks.

methods.name: TestLinkLdapGroup
methods.description: Tests linking an LDAP group by UUID with permission checks.

methods.name: TestUnlinkLdapGroup
methods.description: Tests unlinking an LDAP group by UUID with permission checks.

methods.name: TestMigrateIdLdap
methods.description: Tests migration of LDAP IDs with permission and input validation.

methods.name: TestUploadPublicCertificate
methods.description: Tests uploading LDAP public certificate with admin permission checks.

methods.name: TestUploadPrivateCertificate
methods.description: Tests uploading LDAP private certificate with admin permission checks.

methods.name: TestAddUserToGroupSyncables
methods.description: Tests adding users to LDAP group syncables, including permission, user existence, and sync behavior.
